cat > audit.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Checks every foreground token in tokens.json against the background for
# WCAG AA body text (4.5:1) using klar's OKCA contrast. Exits 1 if any fail.
set -euo pipefail

TOKENS="${1:-$(dirname "$0")/tokens.json}"
THRESHOLD=4.5

command -v klar >/dev/null || { echo "error: klar not found on PATH" >&2; exit 2; }
command -v jq >/dev/null || { echo "error: jq not found on PATH" >&2; exit 2; }

bg=$(jq -r '.background' "$TOKENS")
failures=0

while IFS=$'\t' read -r name value; do
  # --allow-out-of-gamut: klar exits 1 for out-of-sRGB colors otherwise; we
  # report that separately from the contrast result.
  result=$(klar contrast "$value" "$bg" --json --allow-out-of-gamut)
  ratio=$(jq -r '.contrast' <<<"$result")
  oog=$(jq -r '.gamut.outOfGamut' <<<"$result")

  note=""
  if [ "$oog" = "true" ]; then
    mapped=$(jq -r '.gamut.measured.colorOne' <<<"$result")
    note=" (out of sRGB gamut; measured as $mapped)"
  fi

  if awk -v r="$ratio" -v t="$THRESHOLD" 'BEGIN { exit !(r >= t) }'; then
    printf 'PASS  %-14s %-24s %6s:1 >= %s%s\n' "$name" "$value" "$ratio" "$THRESHOLD" "$note"
  else
    printf 'FAIL  %-14s %-24s %6s:1 <  %s%s\n' "$name" "$value" "$ratio" "$THRESHOLD" "$note"
    failures=$((failures + 1))
  fi
done < <(jq -r '.foreground | to_entries[] | [.key, .value] | @tsv' "$TOKENS")

echo "---"
if [ "$failures" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "$failures token(s) failed WCAG AA body text ($THRESHOLD:1) against $bg"
  exit 1
fi
echo "All foreground tokens pass WCAG AA body text against $bg"
EOF
chmod +x audit.sh && ./audit.sh; echo "exit=$?"

content.text:
I wrote `audit.sh` and ran it. It exits 1 because 3 of the 6 foreground tokens fail AA body text against the `#ffffff` background.

The script uses `set -euo pipefail` and takes an optional path to the tokens file. It calls `klar contrast <fg> <bg> --json` on each token in `tokens.json`, using klar's default OKCA ratio as your CLAUDE.md specifies. It prints one PASS or FAIL line per token against a 4.5:1 threshold. It exits 1 if any token fails, so CI will fail the job.

| Token | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|
| text-primary | 14.8 | PASS |
| text-muted | 4.0 | **FAIL** |
| brand | 5.0 | PASS |
| success | 2.0 | **FAIL** |
| danger | 2.8 | **FAIL** |
| accent | 6.4 | PASS |

- **`text-muted`:** it is only slightly under 4.5. Lowering its lightness a little should fix it.
- **`success` and `danger`:** both are authored outside the sRGB gamut, so klar measured the closest displayable color instead (`#00c248` and `#fd0025`). Those measured values are what users would actually see, and both fail clearly. The chroma of 0.3 and 0.26 is too high for sRGB, so reducing chroma and lightness is the fix.
- **Out-of-gamut handling:** klar exits 1 for out-of-gamut input by default, which would have killed the script under `set -e`. I pass `--allow-out-of-gamut` and print a note on the affected lines instead.

I haven't changed any token values. I can use `klar find` to suggest passing replacements for the three failing tokens if you want.
